# netskope_npa_private_app_public_host (Resource)

NPAPrivateAppPublicHost Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netskope_npa_private_app_public_host" "my_npaprivateapppublichost" {
  clientless_access  = false
  host               = "...my_host..."
  is_user_portal_app = true
  protocols = [
    {
      created_at = "2022-05-19 21:03:07.125000+00:00"
      id         = 4
      port       = "...my_port..."
      protocol   = "tcp"
      service_id = 9
      updated_at = "2022-05-19 21:03:07.125000+00:00"
    }
  ]
  real_host = "...my_real_host..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `clientless_access` (Boolean) Requires replacement if changed.
- `host` (String) Requires replacement if changed.
- `is_user_portal_app` (Boolean) Requires replacement if changed.
- `protocols` (Attributes List) Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--protocols))
- `real_host` (String) Requires replacement if changed.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `status` (String) must be one of ["success", "error"]
